items.en: Russia unveils Izdeliye 347, a truck-mounted ground launcher for a modified LMUR (Izdeliye 305) helicopter missile, at Tsentr-2026
items.nl: Rusland onthult Izdeliye 347, een lanceerinrichting op een vrachtwagen voor een aangepaste LMUR-helikopterraket (Izdeliye 305), tijdens Tsentr-2026
items.sEn: At the strategic exercise Tsentr-2026, Russia presented a new ground-based missile system, Izdeliye 347 ("Product 347"). items.en: Russia's Dan-T munition blurs line between UAVs, cruise missiles — Rostec claims S-71M, S-71K and Dan-T jet drones form a new drone-missile class
items.nl: Russische Dan-T-munitie doet grens tussen UAV's en kruisraketten vervagen — Rostec presenteert S-71M, S-71K en Dan-T als nieuwe klasse tussen drone en raket
items.sEn: Russian state corporation Rostec, in comments to the Defence Ministry newspaper Krasnaya Zvezda (30 September) and to TASS, claims that three of its newest jet-powered strike drones — the S-71M, S-71K and Dan-T — form a new category between attack drones and cruise missiles. items.en: Russia unveils 'Dan-T' loitering munition as export counterpart to the 'Banderol' (S8000) missile-drone
items.nl: Rusland onthult zwerfmunitie 'Dan-T' als exportvariant van de 'Banderol' (S8000)-raketdrone
items.sEn: At the El Alamein International Airshow in Egypt (8-10 September 2026), Russia's state corporation Rostec publicly displayed for the first time a full-scale mockup of the "Dan-T" (Дань-Т) loitering munition.
